Pattern: form with validation errors.description:
Server-side validation round trip: return errors with a 400, render them from `actionData`, redirect on success.
Works without JS, and `aria-invalid` keeps it accessible.

body: // While the mutation is in flight, trust the submitted value.
Pattern: optimistic UI.description:
Render the pending submission's value instead of the server's, so the UI responds instantly.
`fetcher.formData` holds what was submitted; when it clears, the revalidated server value takes over — and a failure reverts on its own.

Pattern: optimistic list item.description:
Append not-yet-saved items to the list so a new row appears immediately.
Each fetcher has a stable `key`, usable as a temporary React key.

Pattern: reset form after submit.description:
Clear the inputs once the submission completes — the usual need for an "add another" form.
A fetcher does not navigate, so the form is not remounted and keeps its values otherwise.
